# Loan Estimates

Loan Estimates is a free online calculator site for fast borrowing answers — mortgage and loan payment estimates, affordability snapshots, total interest and payoff dates — plus the full library of 154 calculators. Every figure is an estimate, not a loan offer or financial advice.

Made for home buyers, car buyers and borrowers who want the payment and the total cost before they talk to a lender.

All 154 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://loanestimates.site/): all 154 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://loanestimates.site/embed.html): put any of the 154 Loan Estimates calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://loanestimates.site/partnerships.html): the network Loan Estimates belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://loanestimates.site/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
